dests.name: Kashmir
dests.best: Mar–Jun for gardens, Dec–Feb for snow
hl: Shikara ride and houseboat stay on Dal Lake
Gulmarg Gondola — one of Asia's highest cable cars
Betaab, Aru and Chandanwari valleys in Pahalgam
Mughal gardens: Nishat, Shalimar and Chashme Shahi
dests.about: Kashmir is shikara rides on Dal Lake at dawn, the Mughal gardens in full bloom, and pine valleys that turn white every winter. Stay on a heritage houseboat, ride the Gulmarg Gondola to Apharwat Peak, and follow the Lidder river through Pahalgam's meadows.

dests.name: Himachal Pradesh
hl: The Ridge and Mall Road, Shimla
dests.about: From the colonial Mall Road of Shimla to the cafés of Old Manali and the apple orchards of Kullu, Himachal is India's favourite mountain escape. Drive the Atal Tunnel to Sissu, paraglide over Solang and walk the riverside trails of Kasol.

dests.name: Spiti Valley
hl: Key Monastery above the Spiti river
Langza fossil village and Buddha statue
dests.about: A cold desert at 12,500 ft, Spiti is a road trip through monasteries, fossil villages and the turquoise Chandratal lake. Group departures run through the summer road season when both Kunzum and the Kinnaur route are open.

dests.name: Ladakh
dests.about: Ladakh rewards the slow traveller: acclimatise in Leh, cross Khardung La into the Nubra dunes, and watch Pangong Tso change colour through the day. Every itinerary builds in a rest day at altitude.

dests.name: Uttarakhand
hl: Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar
Nainital lake and Snow View Point
dests.about: Rishikesh rafting, Mussoorie's Camel's Back Road, the lakes of Nainital and the Char Dham shrines — Uttarakhand mixes adventure, hill stations and pilgrimage within a few hours' drive.

dests.name: Uttar Pradesh
hl: Ganga Aarti and sunrise boat ride, Varanasi
Sarnath, where the Buddha first taught
dests.about: See the Taj Mahal at sunrise, the evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, and the newly built Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya. Uttar Pradesh holds India's best-known monument and its oldest living city.

dests.name: Rajasthan
hl: Amer Fort and Hawa Mahal, Jaipur
Camel safari and desert camp at Sam dunes
dests.about: Forts on every ridge, lake palaces and a desert that glows at sunset. Rajasthan's classic circuit covers Jaipur's Pink City, Jodhpur's blue lanes, the golden fort of Jaisalmer and romantic Udaipur.

dests.name: Kerala
hl: Munnar tea gardens and Eravikulam National Park
Fort Kochi and Chinese fishing nets
dests.about: Tea estates in Munnar, spice plantations in Thekkady, and a night on a private houseboat through the Alleppey backwaters. Kerala is slow travel at its best, with Ayurveda and Kathakali along the way.

dests.name: Coorg & Ooty
hl: Abbey Falls and Raja's Seat, Coorg
dests.about: Misty coffee estates in Coorg and the toy train of the Nilgiri Mountain Railway in Ooty. A gentle hill holiday for families and couples, with Mysore Palace on the way.

dests.name: South India
dests.about: Combine the Dravidian temple towns of Tamil Nadu with the hill stations and backwaters of Kerala. Ideal for a longer first trip south.

dests.name: Madurai & Rameswaram
dests.about: Pray at the Meenakshi Amman Temple, walk Rameswaram's thousand-pillared corridors and ride the Pamban bridge across the sea to Dhanushkodi.

dests.name: Tirupati
dests.about: A darshan-focused package with special entry assistance, stay at Tirupati and visits to Padmavathi Ammavari Temple and Srikalahasti.

dests.name: Puri & Odisha
dests.about: Darshan at Shree Jagannath Temple, the Sun Temple at Konark and dolphin spotting on Chilika Lake, all within a short drive of Bhubaneswar.

dests.name: Sikkim & Darjeeling
dests.about: Sunrise over Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill, the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, and Gangtok's MG Marg. Add Tsomgo Lake and Nathula Pass for high-altitude views.

dests.name: Arunachal Pradesh
dests.about: Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass at 13,700 ft and the Dirang valley. Indian travellers need an Inner Line Permit, which we arrange for you.

dests.name: Andaman
hl: Scuba and snorkelling at Elephant Beach
dests.about: Radhanagar Beach on Havelock (Swaraj Dweep), coral reefs off Neil Island and the Light & Sound show at the Cellular Jail. Ferries between islands are included.

dests.name: Goa
hl: Palolem and Cola beach in the south
dests.about: North Goa's beaches and shacks, the churches of Old Goa, and the quiet coves of the south. Add water sports, a sunset cruise on the Mandovi or a spice farm lunch.

dests.name: Maharashtra
hl: Gateway of India and Marine Drive
dests.about: The Gateway of India and Marine Drive, darshan at Shirdi Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir, the caves of Ajanta and Ellora, and monsoon weekends in Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar.

dests.name: Dwarka & Somnath
hl: Somnath Temple and Light & Sound show
dests.about: Dwarkadhish Temple on the Gomti ghats, Bet Dwarka by boat, Nageshwar Jyotirlinga and the seaside Somnath Jyotirlinga with its evening light show.

dests.name: Ujjain & Omkareshwar
dests.about: Attend the Bhasma Aarti at Mahakaleshwar (subject to booking), walk the Mahakal Lok corridor and take a boat around Omkareshwar island.

dests.name: Char Dham
dests.about: The Char Dham Yatra visits four Himalayan shrines between May and early November. We handle registration, hotels near each Dham and helicopter options for Kedarnath.

dests.name: Varanasi & Ayodhya
hl: Saryu Aarti at Ram ki Paidi
dests.about: Two of India's holiest cities in one trip: Kashi Vishwanath, the ghats of Varanasi and Ayodhya's Ram Mandir, Hanuman Garhi and Saryu Aarti.

dests.name: Thailand
hl: Grand Palace and Wat Arun, Bangkok
dests.about: Phi Phi and James Bond Island from Phuket, Pattaya's Coral Island, and Bangkok's Grand Palace and floating markets. Visa-free entry for Indian passport holders (check current rules before travel).

dests.name: Bali
dests.about: Rice terraces in Ubud, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan, cliff-top Uluwatu at sunset and a private pool villa for honeymooners.

dests.name: Maldives
dests.about: Speedboat or seaplane to your island resort, snorkel the house reef and dine on the sand. Free visa on arrival for Indian travellers.

dests.name: Dubai
dests.about: Burj Khalifa's At the Top, a desert safari with BBQ dinner, the Dhow cruise at Marina and a day in Abu Dhabi for the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

dests.name: Singapore & Malaysia
dests.about: Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa and Universal Studios in Singapore, then the Petronas Towers, Batu Caves and Genting Highlands in Malaysia.

dests.name: Bhutan
dests.about: Hike to Tiger's Nest monastery, cross Dochula pass and see Punakha Dzong at the river confluence. Indian travellers need no visa, only an entry permit and the Sustainable Development Fee.

dests.name: Japan
dests.about: Tokyo, Mt Fuji, Kyoto and Osaka by bullet train. Cherry blossom departures in spring and autumn foliage tours in November.

dests.name: Vietnam
dests.about: Overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay, the Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills and the lantern-lit old town of Hoi An.

dests.name: Europe
dests.about: London, Paris, Switzerland and Italy on escorted group tours with Indian meals, or tailor-made for couples and families.

dests.name: Australia
dests.about: Sydney Opera House, the Great Ocean Road, and the Great Barrier Reef from Cairns. Couple departures include reef cruises and a Gold Coast theme park day.

dests.name: Bahrain
dests.about: A short-haul Gulf break: Bahrain Fort, the Tree of Life, marinas and the Formula 1 circuit at Sakhir.

dests.name: Nepal
dests.about: Kathmandu's Durbar Squares, Pashupatinath, a mountain flight past Everest and lakeside Pokhara. No visa for Indian citizens.

dests.name: Mauritius
dests.about: Île aux Cerfs, the seven-coloured earth of Chamarel and the underwater waterfall viewpoint of Le Morne. Visa-free for Indian passport holders.

dests.name: Meghalaya
hl: Double-decker living root bridge at Nongriat
Boating on the clear Umngot river at Dawki
Nohkalikai, Seven Sisters and Wei Sawdong falls
Mawlynnong village and the Sky View bamboo tower
dests.about: Meghalaya is waterfalls that drop off green cliffs, living root bridges built by Khasi villages over centuries, and the crystal-clear Umngot river at Dawki. Base yourself in Shillong and Cherrapunjee (Sohra), walk to Nongriat's double-decker root bridge, and end in Mawlynnong, often called Asia's cleanest village.

dests.name: Sri Lanka
hl: Sigiriya rock fortress and Dambulla cave temples
Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Kandy
Scenic train ride from Nuwara Eliya to Ella
Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam's Peak
Beach time and Galle Fort on the south coast
dests.about: Sri Lanka packs ancient rock fortresses, tea country and palm-fringed beaches into a small island. Climb Sigiriya at sunrise, see the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy, take the blue train through the hills to Ella, and finish on the south-west coast at Bentota or Galle.

dests.name: Georgia
hl: Old Tbilisi, Narikala Fortress and sulphur baths
Gergeti Trinity Church below Mount Kazbek
Ananuri Fortress and the Georgian Military Road
Batumi boulevard on the Black Sea
dests.about: Georgia sits where Europe meets Asia: cobbled old-town Tbilisi with sulphur baths, the Gergeti Trinity Church under Mount Kazbek, wine villages of Kakheti and the Black Sea at Batumi. Indian passport holders can apply for an e-visa.

dests.name: Kazakhstan (Almaty)
hl: Kok Tobe hill and Almaty's bazaars
dests.about: Almaty is a green city at the foot of the Tian Shan mountains, and an easy visa-free trip for Indians (check current rules). Ride up to Shymbulak, see the turquoise Big Almaty Lake, and drive out to Charyn Canyon and the Kolsai lakes.

dests.name: Kenya (Masai Mara)
dests.best: Jul–Oct for the migration; Jan–Mar dry season
hl: Morning and evening game drives in the Masai Mara
Great Migration river crossings (Jul–Oct, not guaranteed)
dests.about: The Masai Mara is East Africa's classic safari: open grassland with lion, cheetah, elephant and, from July to October, the wildebeest migration and its river crossings. Combine game drives with Lake Naivasha and a night in Nairobi.
